mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, platform_code, so_id, so_code, shop_id, shop_name, track_no, trade_create_time, out_bound_time, warehouse_name
mapper.select: SELECT ad.id, add.id as detailId, ad.platform_code AS platformCode, ad.so_id AS soId, ad.so_code AS soCode, ad.shop_id AS shopId, ad.shop_name AS shopName, ad.track_no AS trackNo, ad.trade_create_time AS tradeCreateTime, ad.out_bound_time AS outBoundTime, ad.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, ad.is_outstock AS isSystemOut, add.platform_sku as platformSku, add.sku_no as skuNo, add.order_line_qty as qty FROM aliexpress_delivery ad INNER join aliexpress_delivery_detail add on ad.id = add.main_id and add.is_deleted = false WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} and ad.is_deleted = FALSE
